newsitem.title: USA: Calif unemployment rate drops to 7.0 pct - officials.
newsitem.headline: Calif unemployment rate drops to 7.0 pct - officials.

text.p: California's unemployment rate declined to 7.0 percent in September from a revised 7.1 percent in August, Gov. Pete Wilson's office said on Friday.
Construction, manufacturing, transportation, retail and wholesale trade and services continued to post gains, adding over 290,000 jobs over the year.
California's unemployment rate is now the lowest since January 1991 and employment in the state is the highest it has been since June 1990, Wilson said.
"We tightened our belts in the early 1990s -- we cut regulations and bureaucratic red tape, reformed the workers' compensation system, and cut taxes," Wilson said.

"All these efforts and many more are paying big dividends to our state's work force," Wilson, a Republican, said. He added that the latest employment figures "show once again that the California comeback is strong and steady."
